meta.how_to_use: This file is the ONLY source of business facts for the receptionist. Change a field's status to 'verified' and put the real value in 'value' only after the business owner has confirmed it in writing. A field marked 'verified' that still holds its placeholder is treated as unverified, so a half-finished edit can never reach a customer.
meta.do_not: Never fill in a price, address, phone number or procedure that the owner has not confirmed. The receptionist will politely offer a human instead.

address.description: Physical office / branch address customers can travel to.

phone.description: Main telephone number customers should call.

whatsapp_number.description: The WhatsApp Business number (once Phase 6 is done).

opening_hours.description: Office hours, plus whether the parlour is contactable after hours.

services.description: Approved list of services and package names, exactly as the owner words them.

prices.description: Approved price list or the approved way to quote. Never guessed.

collection_procedure.description: How a family requests a collection of the deceased, and who handles it.

payment_methods.description: Approved payment methods (EFT, cash, etc.) and account-holder details policy.

staff_contact.description: Where staff alerts should eventually go (phone, email or WhatsApp group).

emergency_procedure.description: What a family should do after hours or in an emergency.

service_area.description: Towns, suburbs or radius the parlour serves.
